Spheal

Ice Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Spheal is an Ice/Water-type Clap Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 39.5 kg. It evolves into Sealeo. Its highest base stat is HP (70), with a base stat total of 290.
